summary: Remove ten generated helpers in internal/cli/helpers.go that no Dropbox command calls (endpoint positional-arg usage helpers, stdin secret reader, response-path pagination wrapper, query-param retention, binary-response delivery).
reason: Dogfood flagged them as dead and the scorecard dead_code dimension scored 0/5. Every Dropbox endpoint is an RPC POST, so the GET pagination and positional-arg plumbing has no caller.
validated_outcome: dogfood reports Dead Functions 0 and scorecard dead_code 5/5; go build, go vet, and go test ./... pass. If a reprint re-emits these helpers with no caller, drop them again.
